description: Per-exam grouping for the study-notes PDFs. The same source markdown can be rebuilt under multiple exam-target labels (Banks vs SSC/RRB) with a focus appendix selected by `focus_for`.

books.title: Polity & Constitution — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, Banks (GA), State PSC — Indian Constitution + Governance

books.title: History — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, Banks (GA), State PSC — Ancient → Modern + World

books.title: Geography — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, Banks (GA), State PSC — Physical, Indian, World, Human

books.title: Economics — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, Banks (GA + Banking), State PSC — Indian Economy + Banking Awareness

books.title: Physics — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, State PSC, Banks (GA) — General Science

books.title: Chemistry — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, State PSC, Banks (GA) — General Science

books.title: Biology — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, State PSC, Banks (GA) — General Science + Health

books.title: Environment & Ecology — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, State PSC — Biomes, Climate, Acts, Protected Areas

books.title: Science & Technology — Common Book
books.subtitle: SSC, RRB, Banks (GA), State PSC — ISRO, DRDO, Computers, Defence Tech

books.title: General Knowledge — Common Book
books.subtitle: All exams — Awards, Sports, Days, People, Books, Culture

books.title: Vocabulary — Cluster-Based Book
books.subtitle: All exams — Roots, Suffixes, Confusables, OWS, Idioms, Foreign phrases

books.title: Arithmetic — for SSC & RRB
books.subtitle: Tier-1/2 focus: arithmetic core + geometry + mensuration + DI; less DI-caselet

books.title: Quantitative Aptitude — for Banks
books.subtitle: Banking focus: arithmetic + DI-caselets + data analysis + quadratic comparison + approximation

books.title: Reasoning — for SSC & RRB
books.subtitle: SSC/RRB focus: series, classification, analogy, blood-relations, direction, non-verbal, syllogism (basic), coding-decoding

books.title: Reasoning — for Banks
books.subtitle: Banking focus: puzzles (linear, circular, floors, scheduling), input-output, syllogism (advanced), coded inequality, data sufficiency, machine I/O

books.title: English — for SSC & RRB
books.subtitle: SSC/RRB focus: vocabulary (synonyms, antonyms, OWS, idioms, spelling), error spotting, fill-blanks, sentence improvement

books.title: English — for Banks
books.subtitle: Banking focus: reading comprehension, cloze test, para-jumbles, sentence rearrangement, error spotting (new pattern)

books.title: Statistics — The JSO Mastery Book
books.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier-2 Paper II (Junior Statistical Officer / Statistical Investigator) — 95%+ targeted

books.title: AAO — General Studies (Finance & Economics) Mastery Book
books.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier-2 Paper III — Assistant Audit Officer / Assistant Accounts Officer — 95%+ targeted

naming_convention: If a book is shared across exam families, name it 'subject_familyA_familyB.pdf' (e.g., polity_ssc_rrb_banks_psc.pdf). If a book is exam-specific (different syllabus weight), name it 'subject_family.pdf' (e.g., reasoning_banks.pdf). The PDF cover page always lists which exam families it serves.
